description: This file defines an Angular component 'ResourcesPageComponent' which displays a list of educational resources with search functionality. It imports Angular core modules, forms, common pipes, and a resource service. The component includes template code for rendering resources and search controls, and contains logic for fetching and displaying resources based on user search input.

classes.name: ResourcesPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays educational resources and allows searching.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Fetches resources filtered by the search query and updates the displayed list.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that triggers initial resource load on component initialization.
